primary_dataset.dataset_name: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
primary_dataset.paper: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web (Deng et al., NeurIPS 2023)
available_fields: action_reprs (list[str]: human-readable action trajectory step strings)
actions (list[dict]: detailed action objects with action_uid, operation: op, original_op, value)
raw_html (str: raw DOM tree snapshot before action)
primary_dataset.suitability_assessment: EXCELLENT. Native human-verified interaction traces directly coupled with high-level user instructions across diverse real-world websites.

external_benchmark.dataset_name: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
external_benchmark.paper: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments (Xie et al., NeurIPS 2024)
external_benchmark.number_of_trajectories: Execution-based agent trajectories (stored in external evaluation run archives)
external_benchmark.number_of_websites_domains: 10 desktop application domains (Chrome, GIMP, LibreOffice Calc/Writer/Impress, Thunderbird, VLC, VS Code, OS, Multi-apps)
missing_fields: native_human_action_trajectories_in_task_spec (action trajectories are not stored inside task JSONs; they are generated dynamically during agent VM execution or downloaded as external model run zips)
external_benchmark.suitability_assessment: AUDITED FOR GENERALIZATION. Serves as desktop environment generalization benchmark. For goal-to-workflow retrieval training, Mind2Web provides natively paired human execution workflows, whereas OSWorld decouples tasks from execution traces.
